schedule.withinBlock: cases order; no replacement or selected repeats

metric.name: all-attempt-input-and-cache-tokens
metric.thinking: subset of output; report separately if known, never add again

netBenefitGuards.actualWallMs: on-demand <= full; use completed evaluation-segment interval union, not the idle gap between ABBA blocks
netBenefitGuards.scope: conservative engineering policy, not a business-calibrated threshold

missing.quota: stop immediately; no automatic waiting or bypass
missing.materialOrObservation: incomplete; no default decision and no ticket closure
missing.unknownUsage: report known subtotal and unknown count; do not claim savings
missing.humanMinutes: unknown unless actually measured; never fill zero or claim total-cost improvement

decision.adoptOnlyIf: all 32 source-verified observations complete, all four requiredKnownFields known for every attempt, all quality and net-benefit guards and minimum improvement pass
decision.otherwiseComplete: retain full; keep complete negative evidence

artifacts.roundOriginals: immutable attempt directories with file digests and recoverable archive
